text:
incident-bot: Paging: OTEL export errors to Honeycomb detected for eu-west cluster. 429/backpressure seen from exporter, queued drops increasing. Paging on-call: dmitri (oncall)...

 dmitri (oncall): acked. Looking at otel-collector logs now.

 carol (observability): honeycomb.statuspage.io shows degraded ingest in EU region. Confirmed 429 spikes from exporter.

 ben (eng-runtime): Repro in staging with smaller workload — exporter starts returning 429 if batch_size > 80 or send_timeout < 10s.

 ben (eng-runtime): Plan: temporarily reduce batch_size, increase send_timeout, enable file_buffer exporter to avoid drop-on-fail. Also consider sampling drop to 10% for non-critical services.

 ben (eng-runtime): Patch to otel-collector config I'm going to apply:
```
exporters:
  honeycomb:
    api_key: ${HONEY_API}
    dataset: prod
    send_timeout: 10s # increased
    retry_on_failure: true
    max_retries: 6
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [honeycomb, file]

extensions:
  file_storage:
    directory: /var/otel-buffer
```

 dmitri (oncall): applying quick patch to decrease batch_size and add file exporter to avoid immediate drops. K8s restart of otel collector rolling.

 dmitri (oncall): Command used:
```
kubectl -n observability set env deployment/otel-collector OTEL_EXPORTER_HONEYCOMB_BATCH_SIZE=60
kubectl -n observability rollout restart deployment/otel-collector
```

 carol (observability): started exporters with file buffer. Watching queue length. Currently drops rate falling from ~12% -> ~1.5% over last 3 minutes.

 elaine (support): Preparing customer note. Draft for status page and outgoing N1 email:
"We're currently experiencing partial trace loss affecting EU traces due to an upstream Honeycomb ingest issue. Logs and metrics are unaffected. Estimated impact: 8-12% traces dropped between 03:12-03:30 UTC. Mitigation: we've enabled local buffering and tuned exporter retry behavior. We'll continue to monitor and will update when Honeycomb confirms resolution."

 carol (observability): Opened support case with Honeycomb: HC-4729. Link: https://support.honeycomb.io/cases/HC-4729 (internal)

 incident-bot: Incident severity set to S3 (partial degradation). Notifying oncall rotation for next 2 hours.

 dmitri (oncall): Handoff to alice for next shift in 20m. Summary: root cause upstream ingest backpressure causing exporter 429s; mitigations applied (file buffer, reduced batch_size, increased send_timeout, reduced sampling for non-critical services). Customer comm drafted by Elaine. Logs/metrics unaffected. Ticket HC-4729 opened.

 alice (sre): acked handoff. I'll keep monitoring; if Honeycomb doesn't acknowledge in 30m we'll route traces to fallback S3 exporter and escalate.

 ben (eng-runtime): small note: if we enable S3 exporter, ensure we keep schema version flag on so replaying doesn't break Honeycomb datasets.

 elaine (support): Sent initial customer note to affected tenant list. Will prepare follow-up once HC responds.

 carol (observability): Monitoring: set alert for export_drop_rate > 2% for 15m window and paging to eng-sre.

 incident-bot: auto-update: HC-4729 status: "assigned to Honeycomb eng" at 1769836400.

 alice (sre): leaving a runbook pointer: docs/incident-runbooks/otel-exporter-buffering.md

 dmitri (oncall): resolved for now? We'll keep open until HC confirms. last check: drops <1% and no customer-reported functional regressions. If any production requests need trace linkage, escalate.

 incident-bot: Thread closed for now but will auto-reopen if export_drop_rate spikes above threshold.
